props.name: code
props.meaning: The stored status code. An empty code renders nothing.

props.name: status
props.meaning: The resolved Status row. Supplies the name, colour and icon.

props.name: field
props.meaning: Fallback label source, through its display values.

props.name: variant
props.meaning: Icon-only and glyph keep the label as screen-reader text and a tooltip.

props.name: color
props.meaning: Paints the badge in the status colour instead of the neutral surface.

props.name: label
props.meaning: Which of the two the badge shows. The other one is the tooltip.

props.name: site_url
props.meaning: The site the stock sprite is served from. Needed only for a sprite cell outside the status icon set.

props.name: removable
props.meaning: Draws a remove control inside the pill, after the label. `variant="icon"` and `variant="glyph"` have no room for it and ignore this.

props.name: on_remove
props.meaning: Fires with the code when the remove control is pressed.

props.name: remove_label
props.meaning: The accessible name of the remove control.

keyboard.does: Reaches the remove control of a removable badge. The badge itself is not focusable
